keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Cambuur 1, Go Ahead Eagles 0. Ismaël Baouf (Cambuur) header from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Rafik El Arguioui with a cross following a corner.
Goal! Cambuur 2, Go Ahead Eagles 0. Jason Çeka (Cambuur) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Devid Eugene Bouah with a cross.
Goal! Cambuur 3, Go Ahead Eagles 0. Billy van Duijl (Cambuur) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ilyès Hamache with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Ismaël Baouf (Cambuur).
Delay in match because of an injury Victor Edvardsen (Go Ahead Eagles).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Nicky Souren (Cambuur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Cambuur 3, Go Ahead Eagles 0.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Stefán Sigurdarson replaces Evert Linthorst.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Thibo Baeten replaces Oskar Sivertsen.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Tomas Galvez replaces Dean James.
Thibo Baeten (Go Ahead Eagles) is shown the yellow card.
Nicolas Binder (Cambuur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Cambuur. Sami Bouhoudane replaces Nicolas Binder.
Substitution, Cambuur. Ethan Apkakou replaces Mathieu Maertens.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Richonell Margaret replaces Victor Edvardsen.
Substitution, Cambuur. Daan Visser replaces Nicky Souren.
Substitution, Cambuur. Iwan Henstra replaces Jason Çeka.

Goal! Cambuur 4, Go Ahead Eagles 0. Rafik El Arguioui (Cambuur) right footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Sami Bouhoudane with a through ball following a fast break.
Delay in match (Cambuur).
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Yassir Salah Rahmouni replaces Mathis Suray.
Substitution, Cambuur. Skye Vink replaces Rafik El Arguioui.
Delay in match (Cambuur).
Second Half ends, Cambuur 4, Go Ahead Eagles 0.
